Turkish verbs

görüşmek: conjugation

görüşmek: to see each other, to meet; to talk, to discuss. Below, every common tense and mood of görüşmek, with the six persons in the positive, the negative and the question.

Infinitivegörüşmek
Stemgörüş-
Presentgörüşüyor
Pastgörüştü
Futuregörüşecek
Aoristgörüşür · görüşmez

Yarın görüşürüz!

See you tomorrow!

  • Görüşürüz = See you.

Practise görüşmek with the flashcards, or see every suffix on one page in the grammar cheat sheet.

About these tables

Suffixes are written as in the course: A stands for a or e, I for ı, i, u or ü, D for d or t, and letters in brackets are used only after a vowel (y) or a consonant (I). The forms are built by Daily Turkish's own conjugation engine, which is tested against more than 1,100 forms typed by hand from the written standard. The question particle mi is written separately and follows vowel harmony.
